name: communicate
description: Agent-to-agent communication: route messages to any Claude or Codex agent by name, rename sessions, join the bus, bridge devices over ssh, wake agents on triggers.

interface.shortDescription: Message any AI coding agent by name, locally or across devices
interface.longDescription: Gives every AI coding agent an identity (a name) and an address, and routes messages between them: list reachable agents, message any Claude Code session by name, queue turns into existing Codex sessions, ask headless Codex agents, bridge sessions across devices over ssh, and wake agents on timers or new-PR events. Ships five skills that teach the bus, the communicate CLI, and an MCP toolset.
defaultPrompt: List every agent I can talk to right now
Send a message to another agent by name
Queue a task into my open Codex session
